semantics.definition: The land: one flat plane in Eidos’s darkest black, with rows of dashed circles round the pool out to its edge, where everything dissolves into dust.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one land every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Be the ground of the 3D world, and its one edge.

measure.band: how far past the edge nothing is left
measure.dash: a dash of a circle’s line
